scientific_integrity: All claims concern iid common undirected atomless edge weights on the complete graph, and are supported by a finite-time martingale/ODE limit plus a late-unseen-vertex bound. Finite checks are corroborative, not proofs of infinite limits.
scientific_limitations: Only fixed-size component densities and their normalized typical-size distributions are proved
Largest component proved sublinear, no sharp maximum-size scale
Not generalized to geometric nearest-neighbor graphs or nonidentical or directed edge weights
Historical priority could be affected by an unlocated general nearest-neighbor or growth theorem
title: Complete finite-component densities in symmetric random-link nearest-neighbor forests
